newsitem.title: POLAND: POLIFARB-W TO MEET ON MERGER ON MAY 30.
newsitem.headline: POLIFARB-W TO MEET ON MERGER ON MAY 30.

text.p: Shareholders of the Polifarb Wroclaw paint-maker will meet on May 30, likely to discuss the changed conditions of the firm's planned merger with Polifarb Cieszyn and a proposal of a bonus issue.

The state treasury, which has a 16-percent-stake in Wroclaw wants the firm to carry out a bonus issue of between 6,375,000 and 10 million shares before the planned merger to give Wroclaw's shareholders more than 50 percent in the merged firm.
"The shareholders meeting is planned for May 30," Wojciech Solarski, deputy Wroclaw president told Reuters but declined to say what topics would be discussed at the meeting.
Originally managements of the merging firms agreed that shareholders were to get 50 in the merged company each.
But Polifarb Cieszyn's shareholders later decided that they should get 53.5 percent, increasing a pre-merger bonus issue for Cieszyn shareholders to 6.375 from 2.98 million shares.
Last week Polifarb Wroclaw said that the treasury ministry, in turn, requested a bonus issue.
Cieszyn currently has 19,125,000 shares, 2,978,820 fewer than Wroclaw, and a bonus issue of that number of shares under the original 50-50 plan had been designed to make up for the difference.
